description: Change a season's title, synopsis, Free to watch / Buy or rent (access; null = the same as the series), buy/rent price (US cents, minimum $1.00, null removes) or rental window. Only the fields given change; the same validation as the series editor applies. A season's trailer is uploaded or replaced with start_film_master_upload (slot season_trailer) and its thumbnail with start_film_file_upload (kind season_poster). Nothing in these tools deletes a film, a season, an episode or a file: the user does that themselves in the film editor (the edit link). Offer what can be undone instead: unpublish it.

access.description: free = Free to watch, paid = Buy or rent, for this season; null = the same as the series (the default). A free season shows and sells no price.

buy_price.description: Buy price for the whole season in US cents (minimum 100); null removes it. Only sells once the season is published with a playable episode.

detach.description: Retired: nothing here removes a file. Any value is refused; a file is removed by the user in the film editor.

film_id.description: The film's public id (from list_films / get_film).

release_at.description: The season's own release date: an ISO 8601 date-time with a time zone (e.g. 2026-12-27T18:00:00Z). Until then the series page shows the season with its date: it can be bought or rented ahead, and none of its episodes can be watched; it opens by itself at that time (an episode with a later date of its own still waits for that). null = no date of its own (the default). A season that is already out cannot be moved into the future.

rent_price.description: Rental price for the whole season in US cents (minimum 100); null removes it.

rental_window_hours.description: How long a season rental lasts, in hours.

synopsis.description: The season's synopsis; null clears it.

title.description: The season's title (up to 200 characters); null clears it, leaving "Season N".

name: update_season
title: Update a season
